snippet.title: False Hero - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
After 7 years of working on this game solo, it is finally released!
It's hard to wrap my head around it. I've been working towards this moment for so many years and I'm super excited to finally get the game into your hands!

False Hero is a fast-paced retro soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies' attacks and turn them into deadly combos. The game focuses on challenging fights, skill mastery, and atmosphere rather than gear management, leveling, or grinding.

You can get the game right now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2538870/False_Hero/

If you want to try it out first, the demo will stay available. Demo savefiles will also carry over into the full game. You can try the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4702340/False_Hero_Demo/

If you end up liking the game and want to talk more about it, I also wanted to link the Discord server. We have a small but dedicated community: https://discord.com/invite/yHUdDcYJZ6

I'm incredibly excited to finally release this game, I hope you all enjoy it as much as I enjoyed making it!
